admission_contract.verifier_rule: Use the original frozen hash-bound attest-full-suite-080.py associated with each proof. Full/soak re-attest against the original immutable qualified_source_root; independently compare exact source/package bytes to the production installation.
admission_contract.frontend_rule: Both backend source_hashes and separate frontend_source_hashes must equal final source. No receipt from an older/different frontend is accepted.
admission_contract.backup_freshness: Archive must be under private Linux devbrain-updates state, after installed receipt and at most 1 hour old. Complete logical export, including vectors and journal, must still match before the claim.

safety_invariants: No name alias, no modifying the 403 allowlist, no standalone bypass of supervisor ownership.
All final proofs, final installed package, runtime, update receipt and post-update backup admitted before production settings/backup payload reads.
No service/scanner/cockpit/background worker; service/engine/UI locks plus lifetime database-writer lock remain held through owned JVM, attempt and 30-second quiet observation.

Fresh qualified production JVM only. No arbitrary running engine adoption, no credential rewrite, no schema/database creation, no restore. Own pidfd plus scope identity and listener inode proof; actual graceful exit is required.
Exactly one historical ID: official failed-to-pending bookkeeping and pending-to-running claim in the same transaction after full-row CAS. The global queue claim method is never called.

Permanent private O_EXCL journal reservation before effect; claim_pending fsynced before DB transaction. Any pre-existing marker, partial write or unknown outcome blocks automatic reuse forever pending separate human-reviewed reconciliation.
Every pre-existing unrelated job must remain byte-equivalent logically. New dependent jobs must remain unexecuted pending in the same project. No new job-key or source duplicates.
Public evidence contains fixed codes, counts and the selected job ID. No raw errors, source/transcript contents, command/environment contents, OAuth data or private journal row digests.
remaining_before_use: Normal future supervisor/Windows allowlist, dependencies and required artifacts integration; add the new pure guard module and helper to the new guard inventory and hash manifest.
Run those guards under the externally observed qualified runtime; do not present the existing 403 result as covering these new files.
Complete final-source software, account, recall, UI, copy replay, final-release smoke and eight-hour gates, then perform the authorized production update and separate fresh post-update backup.

Prepare and review the exact private admission document for one job and one expected attempt. Use installed noneditable 0.8 qualified venv with -I. Launch only through the newly qualified external wrapper.
Observe actual controller/supervisor exit and outer 30-second grace. A successful local controller report alone never means the production retry is qualified.
